editorial:
Imagine waking up on your birthday, getting murdered, and then waking up again on the same birthday. That is the wild ride you get with Happy Death Day. College student Tree is stuck in a time loop where she keeps reliving the day she dies. She has to figure out who is behind the baby mask and why they want her dead before her chances run out. The movie mixes laughs with scares in a way that feels fresh and fun. It never takes itself too seriously, which makes the whole thing easy to enjoy.

Jessica Rothe is fantastic as Tree, carrying the movie with energy and charm. The pacing is quick, and the mystery keeps you guessing until the end. On the downside, some of the side characters feel thin, and a few jokes land flat. Still, if you like horror with a sense of humor, this is a great pick. You can stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for your collection.
endingExplained: In the final twist, Tree discovers her roommate Lori is the killer. Lori poisoned a cupcake and attacked Tree while wearing the baby mask, jealous over a shared love interest. Tree finally breaks the loop by killing Lori and surviving the day. She wakes up the next morning free from the cycle, ready to start fresh with Carter by her side.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves horror comedies and time loop stories.
